resources.string: KinKeep reads your contacts so you can choose who to keep close. Everything stays on your phone. KinKeep has no internet access, so nothing ever leaves your device. Notifications let it remind you to reach out.
KinKeep has no internet permission. Your contacts and notes never leave this phone.
KinKeep helps you keep up with family and friends. Log a conversation in one tap, and it gently reminds you when it is time to call. No guilt, just a friendly nudge.
Everything stays on your phone. KinKeep has no internet access at all, so your contacts and notes can never leave your device. Your notes are encrypted.
Allow access to your contacts and notifications. You choose who to keep close, then log a conversation whenever you speak.
This permanently removes every contact record, logged conversation, note and setting from KinKeep. Your phone\'s own contacts are not touched. This cannot be undone.
